claudeReadyContextPayload.contextSummary:
Tenant: harbortrust-bank
Module: intelligence
Purpose: strategy_context
Fraud Analyst Copilot context assembled for intelligence (risk_ai_copilot): 5 evidence refs are available; all remain synthetic review evidence until tenant validation and promotion.
Profiles: function:Fraud Operations; system:Fraud alert platform; system:Fraud case management; system:AML transaction monitoring; system:Digital onboarding KYC; system:Fraud feature store; data_domain:fraud alerts; data_domain:case outcomes
Key facts: pain_point=Fraud analysts triage card, ACH, wire, digital-login, and mule-account alerts in separate queues with inconsistent case priority rules.; pain_point=The fraud alert platform captures model score and reason codes, but downstream case outcomes are not consistently fed back to the feature store.; pain_point=AML transaction monitoring and real-time fraud decisions use overlapping customer and counterparty fields with different freshness rules.; pain_point=High-risk digital onboarding cases require manual lookup across KYC vendor evidence, device intelligence, and core banking account history.; pain_point=Operations leaders cannot separate true model drift from queue staffing backlogs without alert age, model version, analyst action, and loss outcome in one view.; metric=Fraud alert precision by model version; metric=Analyst case throughput and aging; metric=Confirmed fraud loss avoided / recovered amount baseline
Relationships: depends_on:Fraud Operations connects to Fraud alert platform for the risk_ai_copilot request.; uses:Fraud Operations connects to Fraud case management for the risk_ai_copilot request.; depends_on:Fraud Operations connects to AML transaction monitoring for the risk_ai_copilot request.; uses:Fraud Operations connects to Digital onboarding KYC for the risk_ai_copilot request.; depends_on:Fraud Operations connects to Fraud feature store for the risk_ai_copilot request.; uses:Fraud Operations connects to fraud alerts for the risk_ai_copilot request.; depends_on:Fraud Operations connects to case outcomes for the risk_ai_copilot request.; uses:Fraud Operations connects to AML transactions for the risk_ai_copilot request.
Metrics: Fraud alert precision by model version; Analyst case throughput and aging; Confirmed fraud loss avoided / recovered amount baseline
Risks/controls: model version lineage gaps; case outcome feedback gaps; queue aging mixed with model quality signals
Evidence summary: Fraud alert export with model score, reason code, channel, alert age, analyst action, and disposition fields.; Fraud case management extract with confirmed fraud, false positive, recovered amount, and write-off status.; AML transaction monitoring source inventory and control-owner interview.; Digital onboarding/KYC vendor report with identity verification and device-risk signals.; Fraud feature store design notes with feedback-loop and model governance gaps.
Confidence: good - The cluster has enough semantic depth for dry-run context assembly, but remains synthetic review context with candidate relationship edges.
Known gaps: case outcome feedback gaps; model version lineage gaps; queue aging mixed with model quality signals; Relationship candidates are preserved for context assembly, but are not treated as validated active graph truth.
Recommended next evidence: source-owner attestation; measured baseline extract; relationship validation; operator promotion review

qualityAssessment: Hits the mark for design proof: it can start with a compact executive answer and enrich with evidence, caveats, and next evidence without leaking unsupported claims.
